components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One clear action for the next supported step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: #216B59; color: #FFFFFF; font: 500 14px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #1B5B4B; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9C4F3A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #15473B; }

components.name: Tonal Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as managing an installed environment.
components.css: .ds-button-tonal { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: #C8EFDF; color: #171D19; font: 500 14px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-button-tonal:hover { background: #B5E4D0; } .ds-button-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #216B59; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-tonal:active { background: #AEDAC5; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-button-tonal { background: #15513F; color: #E0E9E2; } }

components.name: Environment Card
components.description: A compact installed environment row with a written runtime state.
components.css: .ds-environment-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: #E1E9E3; color: #171D19; font: 400 16px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-environment-card span { color: #414B45; font-size: 14px; } .ds-environment-card button { justify-self: start; min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid #717B74; border-radius: 20px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: #216B59; font: 500 14px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-environment-card button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9C4F3A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Availability Row
components.description: A selectable catalog row that pairs a distro name with install availability.
components.css: .ds-catalog-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; min-height: 64px; padding: 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #E1E9E3; color: #171D19; text-align: left; font: 500 16px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-catalog-row span { color: #216B59; font: 500 12px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-catalog-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9C4F3A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Desktop Keyboard Input
components.description: Material 3 outlined text entry for sending keyboard input to the desktop.
components.html: <label class="ds-input-label">Send text<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Type to desktop"></label>
components.css: .ds-input-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #414B45; font: 500 14px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #717B74; border-radius: 4px; background: #F7F9F5; color: #171D19; font: 400 16px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border: 2px solid #216B59; outline: none; } .ds-input:disabled { border-color: #C1CAC3; color: #717B74; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Three labeled destinations adapt from bottom bar to rail.
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; padding: 8px; background: #F7F9F5; } .ds-navigation button { min-width: 64px; min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; color: #414B45; font: 500 14px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-navigation button[aria-current=page] { background: #C8EFDF; color: #171D19; } .ds-navigation button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9C4F3A; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-navigation { background: #101713; } .ds-navigation button { color: #C0CCC4; } .ds-navigation button[aria-current=page] { background: #15513F; color: #E0E9E2; } }

narrative.overview:
Andistro is a native Android manager for browsing and operating Linux environments. Its identity is an evergreen field with a mint route-shaped A and a small coral node. The interface stays recognizably Material 3; the brand comes from its own name, mark, and restrained color roles rather than borrowed artwork.

The structure follows familiar Android manager conventions: an app bar, scannable catalog rows, a focused primary action, and navigation that adapts to width. ReVanced Manager, Andronix, and Vendetta Launcher are high-level references only; Andistro does not copy their exact screens or assets.
keyCharacteristics: Original evergreen, mint, and coral identity
Native Material 3 controls and responsive navigation

rules.name: The State-First Color Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a written availability or runtime label; it never carries status alone.

rules.name: The Tonal-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Do not add a shadow to a resting list row or environment container.

dos: Do use Material 3 navigation and controls appropriate to the available width.
Do pair every availability color with a written status.
Do keep Andistro's name, vector mark, and color identity original.
donts: Don't copy another launcher's exact layout, logo, or artwork.
Don't indicate installation support only through color.
Don't add decorative shadows to flat environment rows.
